text: Bug #1 (dayjs.tz with non-string input): root cause identified — `d.tz` in src/plugin/timezone/index.js feeds timestamps/Dates/Dayjs objects through `fixOffset` as if they were wall-clock strings, double-applying the target offset. Fix is a short-circuit `if (typeof input !== 'string') return d(input).tz(timezone)`. Verifying now; ETA ~5 min.
Bug #2 (Convert format Z): investigating the `format('Z')` path in the timezone plugin now. ETA ~12 min.
Bug #1: fix applied (non-string guard in `d.tz`), full suite re-running to confirm nothing breaks. ETA ~3 min.

Bug #2: root cause confirmed — `proto.tz` computes a fractional minute diff when the instant has milliseconds, so `$offset` becomes e.g. -420.00205 and `format('Z')` emits `-07:0.002...`. Fix is to round the diff (upstream behaviour). ETA ~8 min.

Bug #4 (nl locale `Do`): dayjs `nl` returns `1.`/`2.`/`8.`/`20.` while the Dutch ordinal rule used by the reference oracle (moment, which this repo's locale tests compare against) is `1ste, 2de, 3de, 8ste, 20ste`. Fixing `src/locale/nl.js` ordinal. ETA ~10 min.

Bug #5 (weekYear): root cause identified — `weekYear()` only handles the "December belongs to next week-year" case; it never returns `year - 1` for early-January dates whose week belongs to the previous week-year (e.g. 2016-01-01 → week 53 → weekYear should be 2015). Fixing now. ETA ~10 min.

Bug #1 is fixed and checked: `d.tz` now short-circuits non-string input via `d(input).tz(timezone)`. Timestamps, JS Dates and Day.js objects all give the same instant as moment-timezone (e.g. `dayjs.tz(1401638400000, 'America/New_York')` → `2014-06-01T12:00:00-04:00`, valueOf 1401638400000), and the full suite is green (524/524).
Bug #2: applying the rounding fix to `proto.tz` now; ETA ~5 min.
Bug #4: applying the `nl` ordinal fix (`1ste/2de/…/8ste/…/20ste`, matching the Dutch ordinal rule used by the reference oracle) now; ETA ~8 min.
Bug #5: applying the weekYear fix (early-January dates whose week belongs to the previous week-year must return `year - 1`) now; ETA ~8 min.
Bug #1: fixed and checked (non-string guard in `d.tz`); full suite green.
Bug #2: rounding fix for the fractional offset is being applied to `proto.tz` right now; ETA ~3 min.
Bug #4: `nl` ordinal fix being applied now; ETA ~5 min.
Bug #5: weekYear fix being applied now; ETA ~5 min.
Bug #7 (customParseFormat meridiem locale): fix being applied now — the `A`/`a` tokens will consult the locale's `meridiem` function so strings like zh-cn 上午/下午 parse correctly. ETA ~6 min.
Bug #8 (duration 'Creating milliseconds'): just received; investigating the milliseconds path in src/plugin/duration/index.js now. ETA ~10 min.
